title: 重磅联动！《英雄联盟手游》携手NBA：三大顶级球队限定皮肤即将上线
body_text:
快科技5月27日消息，在今日SPARK 2026 腾讯游戏发布会中，腾讯宣布《英雄联盟手游》将携手NBA中国、景德镇青花瓷跨界联动，带来更为丰富的联动内容。
其中包括"湖人神话德莱厄斯""凯尔特人传奇莫德凯撒""勇士辉煌嘉文四世"三款球队限定皮肤、"湖人传奇珑宝""勇士宣言珑宝"两款球队限定守护灵。
同时，由玩家票选出的"青花瓷"主题限定守护灵均即将上线。
此外，全新娱乐模式英雄"喵"化彩蛋也将限时开启，在游戏对局中，每位玩家均有概率触发"变猫"彩蛋，在对局中化身猫猫英雄。
作为英雄联盟IP正版MOBA竞技手游，英雄联盟手游超级联赛常规赛将在5月29日重回线下，呈现"二次元+电竞"开放式沉浸场景，随版本持续焕新的线下专属电竞体验也将解锁。

title: 🎮DK五人沟通吗？宙斯杰斯重锤无敌 伪四杀击碎DK HLE先拿赛点
body_text:
直播吧5月26日讯 EWC2026英雄联盟韩国区预选赛败者组决赛，由DK对阵HLE！
第二局前期DK不断针对下路发起进攻，Lucid蔚多次绕后帮助双人组连续越塔，小吕布赛娜前期一度被打成0-4。但Zeka瑞兹中路持续压制许哥冰鸟，Kanavi巨魔也不断联动边路帮助HLE稳住局势，双方经济始终没有拉开。
中期成为HLE上中野接管比赛，Zeka瑞兹频繁带节奏，宙斯杰斯则在团战中持续完成收割。关键上路团战DK正面瞬间溃败，HLE打出1换5团灭DK并顺势控下大龙，彻底掌控比赛局势。
后期DK几次尝试主动找机会都被HLE化解，尤其野区团战宙斯杰斯重锤伪四杀彻底击碎DK反扑希望。最终HLE高地团轻松打出0换4，一波推平DK基地拿到赛点。
赛后数据：
选手阵容：
DK：Siwoo、Lucid、ShowMaker、Smash、Career
HLE：Zeus、Kanavi、Zeka、Gumayusi、Delight
第一局：🎮
小吕布卢锡安双杀撕破DK伤口 Lucid狂抢F6无济于事 HLE赢首局
第二局：
BP：
蓝色方DK：璐璐、蔚、芸阿娜、掘墓、冰鸟
Ban：泰坦、吉格斯、娜美、巴德、蛇女
红色方HLE：瑞兹、杰斯、巨魔、赛娜、牛头
Ban：维克托、卡尔玛、皇子、狐狸、岩雀
比赛详情：
【2:02】许哥冰鸟线上直接被Zeka瑞兹打出变蛋，双方中单拼至残血，许哥冰鸟还要压线，被Zeka瑞兹抓住机会一套EQ单杀。
【3:45】Lucid蔚来下绕后与双人组越塔击杀小吕布与Delight牛头。
【5:59】Kanavi巨魔来中轻松联手Zeka瑞兹打出许哥变蛋，Kanavi拿到许哥人头。
【7:15】Lucid蔚再来下路与双人组越塔，小吕布赛娜被杀，Delight牛头顶住伤害利用防御塔反杀Smash芸阿娜，双方打出1换1。
【9:08】Lucid蔚再来下路绕后，打出宙斯杰斯TP，双方拉开。宙斯走后，Lucid继续来下与双人组击杀小吕布赛娜，Lucid蔚自己被换人头送给Delight牛头，同时Kanavi巨魔与Zeka瑞兹去上击杀Siwoo掘墓。
【11:18】Zeka瑞兹再去上路配合小吕布赛娜开大与宙斯杰斯补伤害击杀Siwoo掘墓，双方经济持平。
【12:48】上路3v3，Smash芸阿娜先杀小吕布赛娜，Kanavi巨魔同时去下，Siwoo掘墓后撤，小吕布赛娜0-4-3。
【15:50】先锋团，Kanavi巨魔黏住Career璐璐将其击杀，DK三人撤退，Kanavi回头拿到先锋。
【17:11】HLE中路先锋推进撞掉DK一塔，HLE经济领先1k。随后野区团战，Siwoo掘墓框住Kanavi巨魔，Lucid蔚直接锁头进场被宙斯杰斯反杀，Smash芸阿娜开大进场被融化，HLE打出0换2。
【20:44】上路团战，许哥冰鸟推线被抓直接变蛋被杀，Smash芸阿娜进场击杀Zeka瑞兹，但DK众人正面不堪一击，HLE打出1换5团灭DK，回头吃掉大龙，经济领先4k。
【22:25】HLE下路冲上DK高地，Zeka瑞兹先送一个，侧面Lucid蔚带队追击，许哥冰鸟留住Delight牛头拿到终结人头，DK打出0换2，HLE三人后撤，Kanavi吃掉小龙，HLE经济领先4k。
【27:52】 DK入侵HLE野区，Kanavi巨魔被抓交出闪现，双方拉开，宙斯杰斯TP绕后，Delight牛头被Career璐璐变羊送许哥冰鸟人头，野区宙斯重锤落地瞬间三杀，随后下路追击宙斯再杀许哥，宙斯完成伪四杀，HLE打出3换4，经济领先5k。
【31:41】Siwoo掘墓被抓，HLE直接开大龙，DK四人不敢接团，HLE拿到大龙后撤退，经济领先6k。
【32:48】HLE下路冲上DK高地，许哥冰鸟金身结束直接被杀，Siwoo掘墓残血，HLE轻松融化DK打出0换4，一波推平DK基地拿到赛点。

title: LoL InvenInven Global
body_text:
Source: Riot Games
On the 28th, Riot Games officially unveiled its plans for a major update to Act 2 of the 2026 season for its PC MOBA game, League of Legends (LoL).
A key highlight of this act is the arrival of the new champion, Roke. Roke is an assassin with immense potential who uses nails as a weapon; players will be able to play as Roke starting with Patch 26.13, which goes live in June. Additionally, the popular game mode 'ARAM: Chaos' is receiving a major overhaul. The existing augment sets, which combined augments for bonus effects, will be disabled. In their place, some effects will be replaced with new augments, significantly increasing player freedom. Over 50 new augments will also be added, including skill augments that modify champion abilities to provide a fresh experience.
In Summoner's Rift, the 5-player ranked mode, which allows matchmaking only for full parties, will return for a limited time. While this mode has no tier restrictions for party members, it will be available only during specific weekend hours from June 26 to September 6 to ensure balanced matchmaking and smooth queue times. Sanction systems are also being strengthened to foster a healthier in-game environment. Starting this act, a feature will be introduced allowing players to instantly report others who send malicious messages via whisper. This follows the introduction of the early surrender vote feature for unsportsmanlike conduct in Patch 26.10.
A diverse lineup of new skins has also been revealed. The 'Sinful Beach' skin line will feature LeBlanc (Prestige), Hwei, and Brand. To commemorate the 2026 Mid-Season Invitational (MSI), 'Broken Covenant' skins for Aurora, Shen, and Jhin will also be released, with a portion of the proceeds going to participating teams. Furthermore, the 2025 LoL World Championship commemorative skins are set to be officially unveiled this July.
Meanwhile, key developers, including LoL Executive Producer Paul Bellezza, will visit the MSI 2026 event, which will be held in Daejeon, South Korea, from June 28 to July 12, to engage directly with Korean players. The second act of LoL 2026 Season 2 will be available for preview on the Public Beta Environment (PBE) starting the 28th, with the official update arriving on live servers on June 11.

title: 《英雄联盟》2026第二赛段新英雄Locke介绍
body_text:
《
英雄联盟
》英雄联盟2026第二赛段新英雄 Locke 为男性角色，白色头发、黑色墨镜、绿色披风，武器为长钉，其人设为“恶魔猎手”，以手持长钉作为主要武器。
英雄联盟2026第二赛段新英雄是谁
1、拳头确认 2026 年《英雄联盟》仅有一个新英雄，并将其安排在第二赛季上线，新英雄名为 Locke。
2、爆料画面显示 Locke 为男性角色，白色头发、黑色墨镜、绿色披风，武器为长钉。
3、其Q技能 Soul Nail(灵魂之钉) 为向前投掷长钉，疑似直线弹道并可能具备范围伤害。
4、其技能/机制包含 激活第二形态(或切换形态)：会有延迟、环形领域以及银色/石化般状态表现。
5、切换形态期间角色周身持续出现数字特效，可能代表持续掉血或回血。
6、地图上存在可互动目标(恶魔头颅)，Locke 走过去拾取后可能对应 收集“封印圣物” 的玩法。
7、拾取封印圣物后疑似获得移速加成，表明该机制可能影响机动与节奏。
8、上线时间推测：Locke 将在新赛季登陆正式服。

It largely focuses on slept-on picks, specifically in the mid lane and jungle, while trimming down some of the higher-priority picks we have seen crop up.Table of ContentsThe jungle meta in the 26.6 patch notesAzir compensation buffs after previous nerfsSunfire Aegis build path finally addressedPatch 26.6 Full PreviewAzir– We're buffing Azir to distribute some of his power back into regular play capabilities through scaling power that Azir players hopefully will appreciate– Phreak is XerathLissandra– Lissandra hasn't really felt the same since her Q cooldown was…pic.twitter.com/1gXsFanrBC— Matt Leung-Harrison (@RiotPhroxzon)March 11, 2026The jungle meta in the 26.6 patch notesThe patch’s headline changes target Zaahen, whose creative jungle adoption has exploded beyond traditional top lane play. What started as experimentation by innovative junglers, more specifically Rhilech from my EUW bias, is now peaking. Both casual and experienced players are showing how good it is across Elos and roles. Riot identified jungle as slightly stronger than top lane, leading to targeted nerfs.Zaahen’s W, Dreaded Return second hit damage drops from 80/120/160/200/240 (+100% bonus AD) to 70/110/150/190/230 (+80% bonus AD). Meanwhile, E Aureate Rush bonus monster damage falls from 75 to 50. The adjustments aim to cool Zaahen’s jungle dominance while preserving top lane viability, as it’s easy to land the jungle monster cleave with the E dash, and the W is rather strong against the larger packs. Top lane suffers a little, but you won’t see much from it as Zaahen wants extended trades in top lane to abuse his passive build-up.Shen jungle also caught Riot’s attention after recent popularity spikes (credited to xPetu). Despite celebrating the off-meta success, the balance team reduced Q Twilight Assault maximum monster damage from 120/140/160/180/200 to 100/125/150/175/200, particularly addressing strength in lower Elo brackets.If you’re an Olaf player, he’s getting a bit of a buff, thanks to seeing much less
